correctness.rationale: Use integral blow-up coordinates x=1+u,y=1+uv to derive action u'=u(v-1)/(1+u),v'=1/(1-v) and exact fixed ideal (v²-v+1,u(u+2-v)). Both denominators are invertible in the quotient. The stable five-point boundary tree argument globally exhausts supports. Monic equations give integral free rank four. Mod3 v=-1+w gives (w²,u(u-w)), standard basis 1,u,w,uw with m²=(uw), m³=0; Jacobian identity and nonzero quadratic terms prove failure of formal linearization. The standalone symbolic verifier passed exact eliminations, characteristic-three relations, tangent checks and six small-field enumerations; enumerations do not replace general arguments.

value.rationale: The fixed equalizer is an intrinsic equivariant-moduli invariant. The collision mixes two boundary and two interior geometric fixed points into an isolated noncurvilinear Gorenstein length-four point, with tangent-to-identity but nontrivial wild automorphism, exposing a qualitatively different degeneration from familiar curvilinear cyclotomic collisions. It gives useful exact local input for characteristic-three quotient studies, without claiming such a classification.
